title: Ride Comfort and Smoothness
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly praise the G60's ride quality as smooth, comfortable, and excellent, with a small number describing it as less smooth or worse than prior models.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe the ride as excellent, very smooth, amazing, and among the best owners have experienced.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say the ride feels less smooth or not as good as earlier BMW models.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention ride or comfort without enough detail to tell whether the experience was positive or negative.

limitations: The sampled fragments are heavily weighted toward short positive statements, so concrete detail on specific ride attributes is limited.
Negative and undetermined examples are sparse, so the sample does not show much nuance about when or why ride quality disappointed.
Examples are drawn from a stratified sample and are not representative estimates of all reviews in the topic.
